body:
## What happened?

Running a vulnerability scan (AWS Inspector) against the Temporal Server v1.31.0 
Docker image surfaces multiple HIGH and CRITICAL CVEs in transitive Go dependencies, 
including packages under google.golang.org/grpc, golang.org/x/net, golang.org/x/crypto, 
and github.com/gomarkdown/markdown.

## What did you expect?

A patch release (v1.31.1) with updated go.mod dependencies to remediate 
known CVEs, similar to the dependency bump releases v1.30.4.1 and v1.29.6.1 
published in early May 2026.

## Environment

- Temporal Server version: v1.31.0
- Deployment: Self-hosted (EKS)
- Scanner: AWS Inspector

comments.body: Thanks for flagging the CVEs. Good timing, we released v1.31.1 clearing the CVEs.

title: Request: v1.31.1 patch release with updated Go transitive dependencies (CVE fixes)
